Scan
====

Available modules for Scan.

Modules
-------

.. raw:: html

   <div class="module-cards">
   <a class="module-card" href="hayabusa.html"><span class="module-card-title">Hayabusa</span><span class="module-card-desc">Hayabusa scan of evtx files</span></a>
   <a class="module-card" href="loki_orc.html"><span class="module-card-title">Loki Orc</span><span class="module-card-desc">YARA/IOC scan of the filesystem rebuilt from a DFIR ORC collection (output of the restore_fs module) using Loki-RS.</span></a>
   <a class="module-card" href="loki_uac.html"><span class="module-card-title">Loki Uac</span><span class="module-card-desc">YARA/IOC scan of the files collected by UAC (output of the extract_uac module) using Loki-RS.</span></a>
   <a class="module-card" href="thor_lite_orc.html"><span class="module-card-title">Thor Lite Orc</span><span class="module-card-desc">Scan of collected file using Thor Lite.</span></a>
   <a class="module-card" href="thor_lite_uac.html"><span class="module-card-title">Thor Lite Uac</span><span class="module-card-desc">Scan of collected file using Thor Lite.</span></a>
   <a class="module-card" href="thor_orc.html"><span class="module-card-title">Thor Orc</span><span class="module-card-desc">Scan of collected DFIR ORC (output of restore_fs module) file using Thor (requires Forensic license).</span></a>
   <a class="module-card" href="thor_orc_ram.html"><span class="module-card-title">Thor Orc Ram</span><span class="module-card-desc">Scan of RAM restored file system from MemProcFS using Thor (requires Forensic license).</span></a>
   <a class="module-card" href="thor_uac.html"><span class="module-card-title">Thor Uac</span><span class="module-card-desc">Scan of collected UAC (output of extract_uac module) files using Thor (requires Forensic license).</span></a>
   <a class="module-card" href="thor_update.html"><span class="module-card-title">Thor Update</span><span class="module-card-desc">Update Thor signature files using thor-util.</span></a>
   </div>
